properties: Native move when both connections reach one runtime; across runtimes a re-attaching harness starts first and the original closes only after the destination is ready and the original is rechecked idle and alone; a harness that locks or forks its conversation closes first and resumes there, resuming back on a failed start and naming the saved conversation if both fail; core ends only the admitted terminals; one owner of the agent and its desk after every outcome; every call is bound to the admitted connection ID and generation; a failed or abandoned move leaves the source intact with a reason; an unconfirmed end or cleanup is reported; a moved agent refuses a second move until it settles
assessment: TLC explores both directions and the native route through admission, start, the fork check, recheck, pin and desk move, second recheck, close-first close and resume, resume back, close and cleanup, and a second move, interleaved with the source turning busy, splitting, ending or starting a child, either connection dropping or reconnecting, and lost or unconfirmed replies (14,086 states). Three sampled seeds replay through the real moveAgentAcross with lease-fenced sides; seven model faults and six production mutants are rejected. The first model found that an unreadable source after a lost close dropped the copy and that a lost start reply did not name the copy. Both are fixed and kept as replay witnesses. The close-first extension found that a reconnect during the pre-close recheck escaped as a raw error instead of a refusal; it is fixed and has a unit test. Probes of Claude Code 2.1.330 and Codex CLI 0.171 (verification/contracts/agent-move-audit.md) fixed which harness starts first.
remaining: Independent acceptance of the model and Q57 mapping. A source turning busy between the last recheck and the close, independent Worlds, a service crash during a handoff and real harness startup are not proved. A close-first move whose Board update fails leaves the desk details on the old address; the agent itself moved. A forking harness that does not report its session is not detected and falls to start-first. Chains of moves are covered by unit tests, not the model, beyond the settle refusal.

partialEvidence.review: Remapped from the serial-controller matrix to a finite model with production replay; independent PR review required.
